issues.where: the mirror image on the table beneath the base (also set-E-03.jpg crops 10-11, set-F-03.jpg crop 12, set-D-03.jpg crop 9)
issues.what: the reflection of the wider glass globe is clipped inside a narrow vertical strip matching the base width, cutting off along two razor-straight vertical lines
issues.fix: raytrace the full scene reflection across the entire table plane with distance-based roughness falloff instead of using a bounded reflection card or clipped proxy

issues.where: the glass sphere and liquid interior (and set-F-02.jpg crops 1-6)
issues.what: the interior scene and background lights are not bent, magnified, or inverted by glass and water, and the globe interior has an opaque slate-blue backdrop disconnected from the dark bokeh room behind it
issues.fix: model inner and outer glass walls with physical IOR (~1.52 glass, ~1.33 liquid) so the miniature magnifies and bends toward the rim and background bokeh refracts through clear regions

issues.where: what lies on the surface around the base (also set-E-02.jpg crops 1, 4-6, set-D-03.jpg crops 9-12, set-F-03.jpg crops 11-12)
issues.what: surface frost is built from thick, opaque matte-white sawtooth ribbon cutouts and dozens of identical smooth white hemisphere pellets sitting on the black mirror
issues.fix: replace opaque white zigzag meshes and hemisphere beads with thin, clear-to-translucent refractive ice crystals, micro-rime roughness maps, and irregular crystalline grains

issues.where: the right half of the wooden base, carved leaves, and brass foot (set-D-03.jpg crops 7-8, 12 and set-F-03.jpg crop 9)
issues.what: a blotchy procedural noise mask turns the walnut wood, leaf relief, and brass rope into flat putty-grey plastic to fake frost while leaving the adjacent pinecone completely unfrosted dark brown
issues.fix: keep the underlying dark walnut and brass shaders intact and layer actual translucent crystalline rime geometry and specular micro-displacement consistently across exposed upward-facing surfaces including the pinecone

issues.where: above the cottage chimney inside the globe (set-F-02.jpg crops 1, 3, 6)
issues.what: chimney smoke is rendered as a rigid, straight-sided inverted cone of stippled white pixel noise shooting vertically inside a water-filled globe
issues.fix: remove the particle-noise smoke cone inside the liquid globe, or sculpt a tiny physical glass/resin wisp if part of the fixed miniature

issues.where: the collar where the glass meets the base in crops 1-3 (also set-F-02.jpg crop 5 and set-F-03.jpg crop 10)
issues.what: the glass sphere ends on a flat horizontal line with no recessed seat, gasket, or contact shadow, and the inner brass collar is an incomplete arc that stops mid-rim in blunt rounded stubs
issues.fix: close the inner brass collar into a continuous 360-degree ring, recess the sphere into a beveled seat, and render deep ambient occlusion and a rubber/metal seal line under the glass

issues.where: the line where the base meets the surface in crops 9-11 (also set-E-02.jpg crop 6 and set-F-03.jpg crops 8, 10)
issues.what: a thick uniform black gap separates the bottom brass rim from the surface frost and mirror plane so the base appears to float above the table
issues.fix: settle the base foot flush onto the tabletop with zero air gap, tight contact shadow, and frost/condensation creeping directly up to and slightly onto the metal contact edge

issues.where: the icicles along the base rim in crops 1-5 and set-D-03.jpg crop 7 (also set-F-03.jpg crops 8-10)
issues.what: low-poly faceted icicles hang with truncated flat horizontal top caps under dry bare sections of the brass rim with no feeding ice sheet, and one icicle clips straight into the carved pinecone mesh
issues.fix: subdivide and organically sculpt clear refractive icicles that merge smoothly into a continuous wet glaze/ice lip over the rim, and wrap or terminate ice cleanly around the pinecone relief without mesh intersection

issues.where: the glass shoulder, right rim, and top crown in crops 1-2 and set-F-03.jpg crop 7
issues.what: the left shoulder is a single 1px line with no glass wall thickness, the right rim has a crisp geometric white studio-card highlight, and the top air bubble is an opaque grey bullseye disc with a 1px vertical pole seam
issues.fix: render physical double-walled glass thickness around the full silhouette, soften area-light reflections with natural falloff, fix the spherical UV pole pinch, and raytrace a clear refractive air bubble meniscus at the crown

issues.where: the frosted lower glass and frost ferns in crops 1-4 (also set-F-02.jpg crops 1-2 and set-F-03.jpg crops 7, 9)
issues.what: visible quadrilateral polygon facets and blocky low-res dark smudge pixels appear across the lower frosted glass, while surface frost consists of repeating flat 2D fern-branch alpha stamps
issues.fix: increase sphere subdivision density, replace low-res smudge maps and stamped 2D fern sprites with high-resolution procedural/scanned crystal growth maps with thickness, normal relief, and rim nucleation

issues.where: the small lights on the cottage eaves, gable, and streetlamp in crops 3, 5, 6
issues.what: cottage string bulbs are flat matte yellow-orange pills with no connecting wire, no emissive bloom, and no warm light cast on the stones behind them (one hangs across the side window frame), and the lamp head is a flat cream box without glow
issues.fix: add physical cord geometry routed clear of windows, make bulb filaments and lantern glass genuinely emissive with warm local bounce light on adjacent stone and snow, and add subtle optical bloom

issues.where: the cottage wall, fence, and pond in crops 3 and 5
issues.what: cottage walls are uniform rounded pill pebbles stacked over black voids without mortar, fence posts are topped with identical smooth sphere balls, and the pond sits in a smooth cutout lip with single-pixel specular fireflies along its front bank
issues.fix: sculpt varied rough-hewn miniature masonry with mortar joints, vary organic snow drift shapes on fence posts, blend the pond shoreline with rough ice/slush transitions, and clamp sub-pixel specular fireflies

issues.where: the tree crown and trunk in crops 2, 4, 5, 6
issues.what: the star topper is a razor-edged flat-shaded polygon primitive on a 1px wire, foliage snow caps look like thick grey clay blobs with dark hard rims, and the trunk is formed from smooth twisted spline tubes
issues.fix: bevel and weather the miniature metal topper and mount, give tree snow finer granular edge breakup and subsurface scattering, and sculpt bark crevices and root flare over the twisted trunk

issues.where: snow particles near the glass and across the miniature in crops 1-6
issues.what: particles are nearly uniform round white spheres (and flat grey circles when defocused) with no individual flakes settled on the roof, pond, or branches, and several spheres clip halfway into the cottage wall, roof, door, fence, and trunk
issues.fix: use varied flaky/crystalline snowglobe glitter geometry, scatter settled flakes on upward surfaces, and add collision clearance so no suspended particles intersect solid meshes

issues.where: the snow mounds and top brass torus on the base rim in crops 1, 3, 4
issues.what: collar snow mixes sharp miniature mountain-peak triangles with smooth bulbous metaball lobes covered in single-pixel white noise, and the top brass rim has horizontally stretched repeating grunge bands
issues.fix: sculpt cohesive real-world miniature snow grain and soft slump profiles at consistent millimeter scale, filter out single-pixel glitter aliasing, and unwrap clean non-repeating UVs on the top brass torus

issues.where: the carved oak leaves, acorns, and pinecone on the base in crops 5-6 and set-D-03.jpg crop 7
issues.what: horizontal cylinder wood grain projects straight across the applied leaf and acorn meshes with sharp uncarved intersection creases, while the pinecone is an array of smooth grainless brown plastic blobs
issues.fix: boolean/fillet carved relief into the wooden body with chisel tool marks and grain/end-grain variation, and sculpt thin fibrous woody scales on the pinecone matching the carved wood material

issues.where: overlapping out-of-focus bokeh discs in the dark background (and set-F-02.jpg crop 2)
issues.what: overlapping background light discs alpha-occlude and darken one another like opaque 2D paint circles instead of summing additively as optical out-of-focus highlights
issues.fix: render actual bright 3D point/sphere lights through a physical camera aperture or composite bokeh discs in linear additive light space

issues.where: the near-black background gradient (also set-D-01.jpg and set-E-01.jpg)
issues.what: faint 8-bit contour banding appears in the darkest navy-black background falloff when inspected past normal viewing contrast
issues.fix: render in 16/32-bit float and apply subtle film grain or triangular dithering before 8-bit JPEG output
